_comment: CSS/text selectors for the Sleeper web UI, kept out of the code because
they are the part that breaks when the site is redesigned. Fix them here
Capture real values with:  python3 submitter.py --inspect LEAGUE_ID
which opens the page so you can copy selectors from devtools.
All confirmed against the live site.
Sleeper uses almost no semantic HTML: controls are clickable divs and
the only <button> is the final MAKE WAIVER BID.
The drop is an <a class='team-roster-item'> inside div.selectable-roster;
clicking the name inside it does nothing.
Name forms differ by context: the players table abbreviates
(T. Ferguson), the claim dialog does not (Woody Marks).
